Harbour wind research

The harbour team installed two weather stations to record how local wind affects the ferry crossings. The test will run for a full season and report the average wind speed at each pier during the morning and evening runs.

The first station is at the entrance to the harbour, where moving air can pass the lighthouse. The second station is next to the dock, behind the warehouse. Researchers will record both measurements every fifteen minutes.

Workers started collecting measurements on Monday. They will compare the new readings with the station maintained by the regional weather office and review gaps in the measurements before publishing the table.
